fonts.display: 'Work Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Times', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Deep Space Violet
palette.role: Primary brand surface — hero background, navigation, dark panels, code/token sidebars, and the product UI shell. Sets the dark-mode identity and creates the canvas against which the teal accent glows

palette.name: Bright Teal
palette.role: Primary action fill, emphasis word in headlines, active tab indicator, and decorative spark. The single chromatic note — rationed to CTAs, highlights, and one word per headline — making each occurrence feel switched on

palette.name: Rich Violet
palette.role: Secondary violet for subtle borders, dividers, and accent strokes within the dark panels. A bridge between Deep Space Violet and Bright Teal on the dark canvas

palette.name: Off-White
palette.role: Page canvas, light card surfaces, body text on dark surfaces, icon fills. The light-mode workhorse — never pure white, slightly warm to soften the contrast against Deep Space Violet

palette.name: Light Gray
palette.role: Hairline borders, subtle dividers, and nav separators on light surfaces. The quietest neutral — present but never demanding attention

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Button borders and disabled/secondary control outlines. Slightly heavier than Light Gray — used when a border needs to define a control edge

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: Body text on light surfaces and maximum-contrast borders where the violet would be too soft. Sparingly used — the violet handles most dark roles
